new = '''def _candidate_orders(v, others, dist, adj, C):
    """Orders in which the participants may be served for root v."""
    orders = []
    bfs = _bfs_order(adj, C, v)
    bfs = [x for x in bfs if x != v]
    orders.append(bfs)
    orders.append(list(reversed(bfs)))
    others_sorted = sorted(others, key=lambda w: (dist[(v, w)], w))
    orders.append(others_sorted)
    orders.append(list(reversed(others_sorted)))
    if len(others) <= 6:
        try:
            import itertools
            perms = list(itertools.permutations(others))
            perms.sort(key=lambda p: 0 if list(p) in [list(x) for x in orders] else 1)
            for p in perms:
                orders.append(list(p))
        except Exception:
            pass
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for o in orders:
        key = tuple(o)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append(o)
    return out


def _deliver(router, v, rv, order, C, n, dist, recipes, memo, routes):
    """Deliver rv units of v's chunks to every other participant.

    Returns the pair-flow list (contributing to routes) or None.
    """
    have = {v: rv}
    connected = set([v])
    lv = defaultdict(int)
    out = []
    for w in order:
        remaining = rv
        senders = sorted(connected, key=lambda u: (dist[(u, w)], u))
        for u in senders:
            if remaining <= 0:
                break
            allowed = set(range(n)) - (C - set([u, w]))
            fl = router.route_max(u, w, remaining, allowed)
            if fl is None:
                continue
            got = 0
            for (path, cnt) in fl:
                rid = _recipe(path, recipes, memo)
                if rid is None:
                    return None
                out.append((u, w, cnt, rid))
                got += cnt
            if got > 0:
                lv[(u, w)] += got
                remaining -= got
        if remaining > 0:
            return None
        connected.add(w)
        have[w] = rv
    return (lv, out)


def _greedy_plan(n, links, caps, parts, r, dist):
    adj, C = _adjacency(n, links, caps, parts)
    router = Router(n, links, caps)
    routes = []
    recipes = []
    memo = {}
    trees = []
    origins = sorted([p for p in parts if p[1] > 0], key=lambda p: -p[1])
    for (v, rv) in origins:
        others = [w for (w, _rw) in parts if w != v]
        orders = _candidate_orders(v, others, dist, adj, C)
        done = None
        for order in orders:
            if set(order) != set(others) or len(order) != len(others):
                continue
            saved_res = list(router.res)
            saved_routes = len(routes)
            saved_recipes = len(recipes)
            saved_memo = dict(memo)
            res = _deliver(router, v, rv, order, C, n, dist, recipes, memo,
                           routes)
            if res is None:
                router.res = saved_res
                del routes[saved_routes:]
                del recipes[saved_recipes:]
                memo.clear()
                memo.update(saved_memo)
                continue
            done = res
            break
        if done is None:
            return None
        lv, flows = done
        recs = _decompose_trees(v, rv, lv, parts)
        if recs is None:
            return None
        trees.extend(recs)
        for (u, w, cnt, rid) in flows:
            routes.append([u, w, cnt, rid])
    return {'trees': trees, 'routes': routes, 'recipes': recipes}


'''
